name: AI Engineer Europe 2026
description: April 8-10, 2026, London (Queen Elizabeth II Centre). 100+ speakers, 100+ sessions, 11 technical tracks. Day 1: 23 hands-on workshops + expo/reception. Days 2-3: keynotes and multi-track sessions. Dominant themes: harness engineering, context engineering, MCP, agent orchestration, design tooling.
